text:
Ria: Hi all — I put in my resignation, last working day 2026-04-24. TL;DR: need COBRA timing, confirm device return, and request a short overlap for knowledge transfer.

Sam: Thanks for the heads up, Ria. Benefits run through 2026-04-24 23:59 PT. COBRA notice gets emailed within ~10 business days after offboard; you then have 60 days to enroll. I'll attach the COBRA packet to your HR profile.

Ria: Can we keep a 4-hour overlap on 2026-04-23 for handover? I'll record and upload to the runbook. Also I have two service tokens for monitoring that might need rotation.

IT Ops: We can extend building and SSO access until 2026-04-25 09:00 if approved. Please list any service accounts now. To find tokens run: 

```
redwood-cli service-tokens --owner ria --json
```

Ben: Exit interview scheduled 2026-04-28 15:00 PT. If you prefer an earlier slot, say so. We'll also create a shipping label for laptop return — standard practice is drop at HQ mailroom or request pickup.

Ria: I'll list tokens: monitor-agent-01, infra-ingest-key. Please don't revoke monitor-agent-01 until we've rotated to the new key. I'll leave rotation steps in the runbook.

IT Ops: Noted. We'll mark monitor-agent-01 for staggered rotation on 2026-04-25 12:00 PT to give a 24-hour overlap. Keycard: return optional on last day; revocation default time 09:00 PT next day.

HR Bot: COBRA notice queued to ria@redwood.com within 10 business days. COBRA enrollment window: 60 days from notice date. Benefits end: 2026-04-24 23:59 PT. Offboard checklist link: https://hr.redwood.com/offboard/3160701234.

Ria: Please keep keycard active through 2026-04-25 09:00 for in-person KT. I'll upload a 12-min Loom and a short runbook summary.

Sam: I'll create the offboard task and include a shipping label. Also will follow up with a note about final paycheck and benefits paperwork.

Ben: Confirmed — offboard task created and calendar invites sent. Thanks for making the handover notes concise.

Ria: Thanks team. Appreciate the smooth process. :pray:
